warnings.message: npm: npx, npm exec and npm x pick the version of a package they download with the release-age delay alone and do not read min-release-age-exclude, so they still hold new versions of @acme/* back for cooldown.minimum
warnings.fix: Install such a package with npm install, which reads min-release-age-exclude, and run it from node_modules/.bin: npx runs it from there without downloading it

warnings.message: Composer: no exact version is pinned, so depcurfew configures for Composer 2.11.1, the latest version it knows
warnings.fix: Use Composer 2.11.1 or a recent version wherever the project is installed; Composer has no setting that pins its version in the project

warnings.message: Composer: config.allow-plugins in composer.json (line 6) allowed every plugin; replaced with the plugins installScripts.allow lists
warnings.fix: Add the plugins that must run to installScripts.allow in depcurfew.json (with the prefix composer:), then run depcurfew apply again
